svg.aria-label: Korext, AI code governance: open standards and a platform for AI generated code. Know which code AI wrote, and prove it met your rules. The Korext mark sits at the center of the places it runs: VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, JetBrains, the CLI, the GitHub Action, Chrome and MCP.
